definitions.explanation: The grand sumo tournament now being held or most recently held. Sumo counts its fifteen-day tournaments as {場所|ばしょ}, so the words before and after are {先場所|せんばしょ} (last tournament) and {来場所|らいばしょ} (next tournament).

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だ。
examples.english: He is doing well this tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今場所|こんばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{休場|きゅうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The yokozuna will sit out this tournament.

examples.japanese: {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}ち{越|こ}せば→勝ち越す：32577_kachikosu⟧、⟦{大関|おおぜき}→大関：12662_oozeki⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: If he finishes this tournament with a winning record, promotion to ozeki becomes possible.

notes:
A word of sumo reporting; ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ here means a tournament, not a place. The six regular tournaments a year are {本場所|ほんばしょ}, named by month or city ({初場所|はつばしょ}, {春場所|はるばしょ}, {九州場所|きゅうしゅうばしょ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧: results this tournament
- {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧: the first day of this tournament
- {今場所|こんばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{休場|きゅうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to miss this tournament

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先場所|せんばしょ}: last tournament
- {来場所|らいばしょ}: next tournament
- ⟦{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}→千秋楽：16501_senshuuraku⟧: the final day of a tournament
